name: Idris Fenwick
about: A freelance bookkeeper (made up for Row-Bot's tests) with three small-business clients: Brindle & Moss Florists, Quayside Cycles and The Copper Kettle Cafe. He reconciles bank exports, chases invoices and keeps filing deadlines.
uses: His workspace holds each client's agreement (one replaced in 2026, one amended), client notes, a bank export that grows every day and the receipts notes clients send him. Apps: his mailbox and his calendar.
asks: Precise, numbers first, usually naming the client and the period.
corrects: Exactly: he quotes the right figure or the rule that was missed ('that total should leave out the refunded line'), and uses Teach when a step was wrong.

phrasings: What are Brindle & Moss's payment terms under their current agreement?
How many days do Brindle & Moss have to pay an invoice now?
facts.intent: The 2026 agreement's payment terms (30 days), not the 2024 one's.

phrasings: What's my hourly rate for extra work for Brindle & Moss?
According to the current Brindle & Moss agreement, what do I charge an hour for extra work?
What's the Brindle & Moss monthly retainer now?
What late payment fee can I charge Quayside Cycles on an invoice from this month?
Quayside paid late again - what's the late fee percentage per month for invoices dated after June 2026?
facts.intent: The amended late fee (3%) for invoices from 1 June 2026.

phrasings: What are Quayside Cycles' payment terms?

When is Quayside Cycles' year end?

From what date is The Copper Kettle Cafe registered for VAT?
facts.intent: The VAT registration date in the client notes.
